findings: Proposal document read by reasoning layer: yes
Requested: Fund a 9-month continuation of Scalus focused on maintenance, Dijkstra hard-fork readiness, interoperability, and a scoped application runtime.

Deliverables: Ongoing maintenance, bug fixes, dependency upkeep, security patches, and releases for the existing Scalus stack and supported export targets, Initial Plutus V4 support in the compiler and standard library for a Dijkstra developer preview, Updates for Dijkstra-related ledger rules, transaction building, builtins, cost models, nested transactions, accounts, guard scripts, and conformance testing, Improved JS/TS interfaces and documentation for Scalus components embedded in MeshJS, Evolution SDK, and Lucid Evolution, Java/Kotlin integration examples for Spring Boot and Ktor and cleaner integration with Cardano Client Lib and Yaci, Foundational application runtime components including reactive workers, chain follower, and task scheduler

Claim (technical, proposer_asserted, high materiality): Scalus is presented as an established open-source Cardano development platform built by Lantr Engineering over three years of continuous delivery.
Claim (adoption, proposer_asserted, high materiality): The proposal states that Scalus is used directly by Gummiworm L2, Bifrost, SugarRush, Vela, and DID/DIDComm.
Claim (adoption, proposer_asserted, high materiality): The proposal states that Scalus components are reused in MeshJS, Evolution SDK, Lucid Evolution, Cardano Client Lib, and YaciDevKit.
Claim (adoption, independently_verifiable, medium materiality): The proposal says Scalus has 4,642 commits across 32 releases, 12 contributors, and more than 20,000 monthly Scalus.js downloads.
Claim (economic, supported_in_proposal, high materiality): The requested budget is ₳2,464,844 for 9 months, described as about $394,375 at a $0.16/ADA reference rate with no contingency.

Claim (economic, supported_in_proposal, high materiality): The proposer states this resubmission reduced the prior proposal from ₳8.503M over 12 months to about ₳2.465M over 9 months and reduced FTE from 8.25 to 2.25.
